meta.title: ASSETRA Private Investors | Vetted off-market opportunities from €100,000
meta.description: A private investment club for investors from €100,000. Off-market real estate below market price, secured real-estate lending and business acquisitions in Slovakia and Czechia. Every opportunity comes with an investment memo including risks.

hero.label: ASSETRA · Private investment club
hero.subtitle: Private capital into off-market real estate, secured lending and business acquisitions in Slovakia and Czechia. For investors from €100,000.

manifesto.label: Let's be honest
manifesto.p1: ASSETRA is not a big name. We are a new investment group and we won't pretend otherwise.
manifesto.p2: But we have something most big names don't: access to transactions that never reach the market — and our own capital at stake. We are not desk financiers; behind us stand companies we built and run ourselves. With every opportunity you receive a complete analysis, including the risks and the downside scenario.
manifesto.p3: We don't ask for trust upfront. It is built through the first transaction we do together.

pillars.label: What we open to members
pillars.intro: Membership is free and selective — for investors planning to allocate at least €100,000 to private markets over the next 24 months. Not every application is approved.

offMarket.title: 01 — Off-market real estate
offMarket.text: Apartments, houses and buildings bought directly from owners below market price — from inheritances, foreclosures and situations where cash and speed decide.

privateCredit.title: 02 — Private credit
privateCredit.text: Lending to real-estate projects secured by a mortgage over property — with conservative LTV and a clear source of repayment.

coInvest.title: 03 — Co-investments & acquisitions
coInvest.text: Entering larger transactions alongside us — from development projects to acquisitions of operating businesses in Slovakia and Czechia.

pillars.memoBanner: With every opportunity you receive an investment memo — valuation, collateral, risks and downside scenario. No marketing brochures.

deal.label: What an opportunity looks like

type.label: Transaction type
type.value: Off-market apartment purchase — regional city, Slovakia

strategy.label: Strategy
strategy.value: Cash purchase within 14 days → legal cleanup → sale or rental

deal.disclaimer: Illustrative example of the structure — parameters differ with every transaction.
deal.whyText: In these situations the seller doesn't need the highest price — they need certainty and speed. Foreclosure, inheritance proceedings, divorce, stalled financing. We buy in cash and close in days, not months. The discount is the reward for speed and certainty, not a coincidence.
deal.memoNote: Specific opportunities, including the full investment memo, are shared only with approved members, under NDA.

journey.label: How it works

apply.title: Application
apply.text: Takes 2 minutes. It is free and does not commit you to anything.

call.title: Introductory call
call.text: A short call about your preferences — type of opportunities, scope, horizon and required liquidity.

dealflow.title: Deal flow
dealflow.text: You receive vetted opportunities matching your profile before they go public. You respond only when you want to.

journey.note: Only a fraction of what we review reaches members — every offer passes underwriting, valuation and legal review.

skin.title: Capital at stake
skin.text: We invest alongside you and carry the transaction risk together with you. That's why we select hard.

direct.title: No commissions
direct.text: We are a direct investor, not a broker. Membership is free — no fees, no hidden charges.

discretion.title: Discretion
discretion.text: Transaction details are shared under NDA. We don't share your data with anyone and we deliberately keep the club small.

form.heading: Membership application
form.title: ASSETRA Investor Application
form.description: Membership is free, but selective. Based on your application we assess whether we can bring you relevant opportunities. Selected applicants are invited to a short introductory investor call.
form.allocation: How much capital do you plan to allocate to private markets over the next 24 months? *
form.assets: Approximate value of your investable assets *
form.ticket: Typical size of a single investment *
form.interests: Which opportunities are you interested in? *
form.note: Submitting the application is free and does not commit you to anything.

consent: I consent to the processing of my personal data for the purpose of assessing my membership application and receiving investment opportunities, in line with the privacy policy. You can unsubscribe at any time.

success.title: Application received
success.text: Thank you. We will review your application and invite selected applicants to a short introductory investor call.
